video_title: LIVE: Pelicans vs. Spurs Pregame w/ Jamahl Mosley 11/21/2026

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on the team's late-game execution and film study
quotes.excerpt: we watched the moment from the four-minute mark of the third quarter into the fourth quarter
quotes.quote: We watched the moment from the four-minute mark of the third quarter into the fourth quarter where things started to just change. Possessions, the defense, a couple breakdowns here, some good quality things that we did, but also the small parts of the game that you can't take for granted. We talk about the value of possessions, the intentionality in everything that we do coming down the stretch, the things that got us to lead, being able to sustain it. Hopefully those lessons were taken from what we watched on film and the dialogue that we had was good.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley says the Pelicans are focusing on the value of possessions and intentionality down the stretch after reviewing film from their recent breakdowns.

structured.context: Head coach Jamahl Mosley discusses the team's film study and focus on late-game execution during a pregame media availability.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on Zion Williamson's physical approach and rim pressure
quotes.excerpt: the physicality, the matchup that he possesses getting downhill, attacking the body, which takes Victor Wembanyama out
quotes.quote: The physicality, the matchup that he possesses getting downhill, attacking the body, which takes Victor Wembanyama out of a lot of things is being able to get to his body early. He does such a great job of roaming at the rim, protecting the basket, but Zion Williamson's speed, strength, and athleticism allows him to get there a little bit quicker to be able to finish at the rim and then the decisions he makes once he touches the paint when Victor Wembanyama is down there.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley explains how Zion Williamson uses his speed and strength to attack Victor Wembanyama and get to the rim before the Spurs star can rotate.

structured.context: Jamahl Mosley explains how Zion Williamson uses his physicality and speed to challenge Victor Wembanyama at the rim.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on Herb Jones's offensive growth and defensive intensity
quotes.excerpt: he is an unbelievable, first-class defender, and I just think that when he's able to do that
quotes.quote: Herb Jones puts a ton of work in and that's a product of it. He spends his time getting in the gym, staying after, getting there early. All those things are parts of it. His defense, he is an unbelievable, first-class defender, and I just think that when he's able to do that and knock down shots as well, it gives us such a boost as a team.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley credits Herb Jones for his offensive growth, noting that his ability to knock down shots while playing first class defense gives the team a major boost.

structured.context: Jamahl Mosley praises Herb Jones for his work ethic and the impact of his defensive and offensive contributions.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on the Spurs' team chemistry and leadership
quotes.excerpt: they have the chemistry, they have the camaraderie of a team and I think that's what coach Popovich
quotes.quote: They have the chemistry, they have the camaraderie of a team and I think that's what coach Popovich has done a great job with that group. They are taking the leadership role of all coming back, but also being able to have a unit that know what they're trying to accomplish. But again, that's something that you look at, you tip your hat to them for that, but also know when you step on the court, how you have to play against a team that is connected like that.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley praises the Spurs for their chemistry and connection, noting that coach Popovich has done a great job building a unit that knows exactly what they are trying to accomplish.

structured.context: Jamahl Mosley comments on the team chemistry and leadership established by Gregg Popovich for the San Antonio Spurs.
